# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: monday.com remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the vendor's plugin repository (`mondaycom/mcp`, commit `11e67e4`).
- Any OAuth client ID in the vendor's plugin is not copied. BoldCreate Connect supplies its own OAuth client.
